rows.definition: Bounded current-state projection of the Vulkan explicit-memory reservation cap: configured limit, live and successful-allocation peak bytes, refusal count, and configuration/accounting validity across every memory heap.
rows.distinction: Observes the allocator reservation ledger; it is neither an admission decision nor readiness, physical residency, driver-overhead accounting, or proof of target cgroup fit. C ABI, Go value and debug label project this same state.
